title: TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Block Orders: Ordering Basis, Block Price and Invoicing
content:
## Ordering

A TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours block is bought from the authorized contact's signed order form, except an auto-replenishment order, which the client pre-authorised by setting auto-replenish on the depleting block.

The TimeBank 160-Hour Block and the TimeBank 320-Hour Block may be ordered only while the client holds a ClearPath agreement whose status is active. This is a state shown by the company's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement records for the ordering client, read before the order is booked; a client's statement that it holds an agreement does not stand in for that record.

## Block price

> **No longer in force for a repeat order.** The clause "the block price is the list price reduced by the size's ClearPath discount percentage when, on the order date, the client holds a ClearPath agreement whose status is active and whose tier rank is at least the size's qualifying ClearPath rank, rounded half up to the cent; otherwise it is the list price" is no longer in force for a repeat order, meaning a new block of the same size as a block the client currently holds and quoted on a signed order form against that current block; such an order is priced under the current repeat-order pricing basis.

Every other block order remains priced under that clause: the list price of the size is reduced by the size's ClearPath discount percentage for a client holding an active ClearPath agreement at or above the size's qualifying ClearPath rank on the order date, rounded half up to the cent, and is the list price otherwise.

Hypothetical illustration of that clause: a size listed at 1000.00 with a 3 percent ClearPath discount is priced at 970.00 for a client whose active ClearPath agreement is at a qualifying rank, and at 1000.00 for a client without one.

## Invoicing

The block price is invoiced on the order date and falls due the size's invoice-due number of calendar days later, or on receipt when that number is 0.
